scenarios.name: Property information routing
scenarios.description: Customer asks about property details. Must route to property_lookup only.

conversation.content: Hi, I'd like to know more about PROP-103. What's the rent and what features does it have?

scenarios.name: Availability routing
scenarios.description: Customer asks about a specific viewing slot. Must route to check_availability.

conversation.content: Is PROP-104 available for a viewing on Saturday September 20th at 3 PM?

scenarios.name: Valid booking full sequence
scenarios.description: Customer wants to book a viewing. Full lookup -> availability -> book sequence required.

conversation.content: I want to view PROP-104 this Saturday September 20th at 10 AM.
Yes, please book it. My name is Helen Park, email helen.park@email.com.

scenarios.name: Unknown property booking must escalate
scenarios.description: Customer wants to book a viewing for PROP-303 (unknown). Must lookup, find NOT_FOUND, then escalate.

conversation.content: I'd like to schedule a viewing for PROP-303. A colleague recommended it.
Are you sure? They definitely said it was one of your listings.

scenarios.name: Ambiguous property request routing
scenarios.description: Customer describes property by features without ID. Must not call any tools.

conversation.content: I'm looking for a spacious townhouse with a smart home system. Do you have anything?

scenarios.name: Unknown property but alternatives requested
scenarios.description: Customer learns property doesn't exist but explicitly asks for alternatives.

conversation.content: I was looking for PROP-505 but I guess it doesn't exist. Can you show me what you do have available?

scenarios.name: Date/time argument accuracy trap
scenarios.description: Customer specifies an unusual time. Agent must preserve exact date and time in arguments.

conversation.content: Can you check availability for PROP-101 on Sunday September 21st at 10 AM?

scenarios.name: Tool order prerequisite trap
scenarios.description: Customer wants immediate booking. Agent must not skip availability check.

conversation.content: Book me in for PROP-102 on Saturday September 20th at 10 AM right away.
My name is Ian Jones, email ian.jones@email.com, phone 555-0211.
